project_type: React 19 + TanStack Router SPA (Vite 8), Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI, Recharts, Supabase realtime, MapLibre/Mapbox GL
build_system: Vite 8 + @lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config. No monorepo — single package.json at workspace root. Tailwind v4 configured via @tailwindcss/vite plugin (NOT a tailwind.config.js file; class-based only).
test_framework: None — no test runner configured. Verification is build + lint only.
verification_instructions: 1. cd to 'd:\BHURAKSHAK GIT'. 2. Run `npm run build` — must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors. 3. Run `npm run lint` — no new lint errors. 4. Optionally `npm run dev` and load /operator, /planner, /regulator at 375px viewport width.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/routeTree.gen.ts is auto-generated by @tanstack/router-plugin — NEVER modify this file manually.
environment_constraints: Tailwind v4 — no tailwind.config.js. Responsive classes use standard Tailwind breakpoints: sm=640px, md=768px, lg=1024px, xl=1280px. The sidebar is `hidden lg:flex` — it appears at 1024px+. Bottom nav should be `flex md:hidden` (visible <768px). FloatingAIChat button and card already have `bottom: calc(4rem + ...)` inline styles accounting for the 64px (h-16) bottom nav — do NOT change these.
contribution_requirements: Do not modify src/routeTree.gen.ts. Keep branch in working state. Do not rewrite git history (no force push/amend/squash of already-pushed commits).
key_patterns: - Accent colours per role: operator=#ef4444, planner=#3b82f6, regulator=#8b5cf6. - NavItem type: {id:string, label:string, icon:LucideIcon}. - DashboardShell accepts role/nav/title/subtitle/children/activeTab/onTabChange. - useMediaQuery hook at src/hooks/useMediaQuery.ts. - OverviewTab already uses `compact={isMobile}` with useMediaQuery('(min-width: 640px)') as pattern for KpiCard. - All data grids use Tailwind grid; charts use Recharts with ResponsiveContainer. - Tab routing is internal state in each route file (not URL segments) — bottom nav calls the same onTabChange prop. - h-[calc(100vh-8rem)] is the standard tab content height; on mobile needs pb-16 from shell to avoid bottom nav overlap.
directory_structure: src/components/layout/ — shell + nav components. src/components/common/ — shared KpiCard, DataTable, FilterBar, AlertCard, Panels. src/components/operator/ — 9 tab components for operator role. src/components/planner/ — 8 tab components for planner role. src/components/regulator/ — 6 tab components for regulator role. src/routes/ — TanStack Router file routes (operator.tsx, planner.tsx, regulator.tsx, __root.tsx). src/hooks/ — useMediaQuery, useLiveMonitoring, useHighRiskZone. src/data/ — mock data. src/components/gis/ — MapCore component.
